title: A Pan-Canadian, Retrospective Evaluation of MitraClip Safety and Efficacy
brief_summary: The PREMISE Registry is a retrospective, observational study that will evaluate the efficacy and safety of the MitraClip in real-world Canadian practice. It will include all patients who have undergone MitraClip implantation in Canada to date.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Patient has undergone percutaneous mitral valve repair with MitraClip Clip Delivery System in Canada

Exclusion Criteria:

* none
study_population: All patients who have undergone percutaneous mitral valve repair with the MitraClip Clip Delivery System in Canada.
